calculation.description: Cross-sectional reversal of five-day shocks, volatility scaled and activated only when average cross-asset 20-day return dispersion is above its trailing 70th percentile. The complete signal is lagged one trading day before measuring forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate IC/ICIR across 2779 dates and all 15 assets; regime IC/ICIR: 2024-26 0.033435/0.101760, 2027-29 0.006892/0.025393, 2030-32 0.007015/0.027684, 2032-33 0.045367/0.150651. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty; signal is intentionally inactive outside elevated dispersion.
